run_daily.description: Whether the daily cron job should run chkrootkit at all.

diff_mode.description: Whether to show changes since last run using diff(1).

filter.description: Shell command to filter chkrootkit output.

ignore_file.description: Path to file containing regex patterns for lines to ignore.

mail_to.description: Email addresses to send scan results to.

mail_subject.description: Subject line for email notifications. Empty uses default.

ionice_enabled.description: If true, use ionice when running chkrootkit.

log_dir.description: Directory where output and logs are saved.
